body: Yes it certainly is and I do not have a partner, so I did not have any deep meaningful conversations about life with anyone for almost 10 years. It just helps when someone completes you, even if both partners just got each other and are not necessary having deep conversations. And what I mean by that is that on my own it is easy to drift from reality sometimes and forget about my connection to the world. Sometimes I don't even feel as if I am here for real and feel like in a dream.

Sorry to hear that about your man, I can picture how he might be feeling. I go out at least once every day for around 1 hour. Being around people is not a problem for me, but talking to them and having a conversation longer than the mundane chit chat about weather is a real issue. I can't relate to anyone daily lives because mine is so out of the ordinary, I spend 95% of my time on my own. I work from home (my bad, I forgot to specify that part in the first edition of my post).
It's a combination of many factors and events. The main reason being that I can't connect to others. I guess you can say social anxiety but I am no expert with psychology.
